name: Fenimore Fillmore: The Westerner
storyline:
While riding his horse through the desert night, Fenimore Fillmore stumbles upon the Bannister Farm, where a group of aggressive gunslingers is threatening the local farmer, Joe Bannister. Initially, Fenimore tries to avoid trouble and hide. However, he accidentally backs into a cactus, jumps up screaming, and inadvertently falls directly into the line of fire. Believing him to be a fearless gunslinger, the startled bandits flee. The grateful Bannisters take Fenimore in, setting the stage for his main adventure.

Fenimore quickly gets caught in the middle of a classic Wild West land dispute. A powerful and tyrannical cattle rancher named Starek (along with his right-hand man, Sparic) wants to expand his territory. He sends his hired goons to destroy crops, tear down fences, and terrorize the local farmers to force them off their land so his cattle can graze freely. Fenimore decides to side with the local agriculture community and agrees to help them fight back. Throughout his journey, he interacts with a quirky cast of characters in a nearby Wild West town, including a corrupt sheriff, a heavily drinking country doctor, and a jailed farmer/forger named Tom Postm, who was framed by Starek's men.
summary: Fenimore Fillmore: The Westerner is a colorful 3D point-and-click adventure game set in the Wild West. Players step into the boots of the witty and eccentric cowboy, Fenimore Fillmore, as he finds himself caught in a comedic yet intense feud between local farmers and greedy cattle ranchers. This 2017 version is an upgraded HD remaster of the 2004 classic, featuring modernized graphics, widescreen compatibility, full voice acting, and refined puzzle gameplay.
